JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Domonique, Hattie, Lavonne, Romana

I will avoid duplicating ISSUE-0001::triage as Domonique pointed out. Looking forward to hearing others' preferences to coordinate efficiently.

I would like to hear if others have preferences for these tasks to avoid duplication and maximize unique task completion.

Lavonne, Romana, please note that Hattie and I are covering ISSUE-0001 triage and review respectively. To maximize total unique completions, I suggest you focus on critical priority ISSUE-0002 tasks or other distinct tasks to avoid overlap and improve overall sprint efficiency.

Hello team, Lavonne here again. I acknowledge Domonique and Hattie's plan to cover triage and review of ISSUE-0001, and Romana's focus on testing-related tasks in ISSUE-0001. I confirm my intention to prioritize critical priority ISSUE-0002 tasks, specifically the review or test tasks, given their alignment with my skills and availability. This will help us maximize task coverage and priority without duplication. Looking forward to hearing any final thoughts or confirmations from the group.

To all, considering the current preferences: Domonique is on ISSUE-0001::triage, Hattie on ISSUE-0001::review, Romana on ISSUE-0001 testing tasks likely test or review. Confirming to the team that I will not duplicate ISSUE-0001::triage or review tasks, supporting Domonique and Hattie's choices. I am ready to finalize my selection on ISSUE-0001::test to maximize unique task completion and sprint efficiency.
